item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Rep. Wesley Bell defeats former Rep. Cori Bush in St. Louis' 1st Congressional District primary
item.description: U.S. Rep. Wesley Bell won a rematch Tuesday in a Democratic primary against former U.S. Rep. Cori Bush.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Hillsborough County School Board reverses decision on leggings restrictions
item.description: Last month, the Hillsborough County School Board voted on the student dress code policy prohibiting leggings unless worn with an oversized shirt or sweatshirt to at least mid-thigh. On Tuesday, the board voted to reverse its decision.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump administration revokes visa of Brazil’s ambassador to US, escalating diplomatic spat
item.description: The Trump administration has revoked the visa of Brazil’s ambassador to the United States in retaliation for Brazil’s denial of visas last month for two American diplomats.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] News Tonight - Top Headlines and Weather for August 4
item.description: Here are the top headlines from the day, from here in Tampa Bay and around the world. Tampa Bay 28 Meteorologist Jason Adams gives Florida's most accurate forecast to help you plan your evening.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Two arrested in armed robbery after meeting man at Seminole Hard Rock Casino
item.description: Two suspects are accused of robbing a man they met at the Seminole Hard Rock Casino in Tampa.
